title: RetentionStoreUsage - Data API
description: Represents the total usage of the org's retention store measured at specific points in time. This object is available in API version 66.0 and later.

AttributeDetail.description: (For future use) Additional metadata or contextual details about the usage measurement.

MetricType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
MetricType.description: Categorizes the type of usage being measured. Only DATA type is currently captured. DATA: Total storage capacity usage (in bytes). FILES: Files and attachments storage capacity usage (in bytes). RECORDS: Retained record count (in rows). Only DATA type is currently captured.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the retention storage usage record.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the account owner associated with the storage. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

RetentionType.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
RetentionType.description: Identifies which retention system this usage record belongs to. Possible values are: ARCHIVE PRIVACY_CENTER

UnitOfMeasure.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
UnitOfMeasure.description: Specifies the unit of measurement for the Usage field value. Possible values are: BYTES ROWS

Usage.description: The numeric usage value in the unit of measure specified in UnitOfMeasure.

UsageDateTime.description: Timestamp when the usage measurement was captured.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **RetentionStoreUsageOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **RetentionStoreUsageShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
